description.en: When Earth loses its heat energy, humans will land in a predicament of extreme coldness. An impoverished young lady who lives alone meets a non-human young man who brings his own heat energy. He is handsome and has exceptional abilities, but he is too laid-back. While disrupting the girl’s plans, various troubles, which were difficult to contain, evolved. Who is he? Where is he from? The girl is currently standing at the fork between love and community. Which will she choose?
description.tr: Dünya ısı enerjisini kaybetti ve insanlar aşırı soğukluk ile karşı karşıya kaldı. Yalnız yaşayan yoksul bir genç kız, kendi ısı enerjisini getiren ve insan olmayan bir genç adamla tanışır. Yakışıklı ve olağanüstü yetenekleri var ama çok rahat. Kızın planlarını bozarken, içinde barındırılması güç çeşitli sıkıntılar baş gösterdi. Kim o çocuk? O nereli? Kız şu anda aşk ve topluluk birini seçmek zorunda. Peki hangisini seçecek?

description.en:
What to do when you're a young Asian immigrant, living in a European slum, with no choice but to hit rock-bottom?  
  
On the usual menu, blackmailing, theft, prostitution…until one day, enough is enough. But the mafia won’t stand for that!  
  
Narrowly escaping the people who wanted him dead, Maoye is then picked up by a bizarre old woman. Taken care of in her hut filled with killer bees, he must listen to the strange stories she tells him every day. A story of wild young kids, even wilder and younger than him. They're on the run as well…but ready to do anything to find love and peace, no matter the price!

Hibiscus, a genius young lady, joined a research and development project by a game developing company and activated a holographic AI, NET. At first, she didn’t like this chatty AI with no filter, but going through a fantastical game adventure together made Hibiscus change her impression of him. Perhaps that is when she really got to know this suspicious AI bit by bit.

description.en:
The path to immortality is fraught with difficulty! Especially in this cultivation world, utterly altered by a plague!
Mortals carry the disease; if immortals come into contact with them, their cultivation will at best decline, and at worst, they will be banished from the mortal realm, forever separated from the immortals.

I, having transmigrated here with boundless ambition, am destined to toil in the mortal world, wasting my life.
Fortunately, at the moment of my death, I awaken a wondrous treasure, capable of transforming reality into illusion, turning my real life into a fleeting dream, returning me to the moment I transmigrated!

**Thus, I begin my long and arduous journey of reincarnation!**
description.pt-br:
Quão árduo é o caminho da imortalidade!? E isso sem falar em um mundo de cultivo completamente transformado por uma praga!

Mortais se tornaram portadores da praga, se um imortal tiver contato com eles, no melhor dos casos sua cultivação regredirá. No pior, seu Dao retornará aos céus. Assim, os reinos imortal e mortal foram para sempre separados.

Transmigrado para esse mundo com ambições que tocavam os céus, tudo o que pude fazer foi definhar na poeira mortal, desperdiçando toda a minha vida.

Felizmente, no meu leito de morte, finalmente despertei um tesouro único. Ele pode transformar o real em ilusório, convertendo toda a minha vida em um sonho passageiro e permitindo que eu volte ao momento em que cheguei!

Assim começou minha longa e árdua jornada em busca da vida eterna.

description.en: Kali grows up through the deaths of her close ones. Set in a historical-like world with monsters known as "slave ghosts".

Twin detectives Xiaotu and Xiaohu set up a business that specializes in dealing with supernatural occurrences. However, when they investigate what seems to be an ordinary “Supernatural” case, a series of bizarre events unfold. To that end, Xiaotu and Xiaohu conquer hardships with every step they take, to clear the hazy path towards the truth.

In the middle of an infinity of worlds, which respect the rule of non-interference, there lives a Savior in the city, who protects the people. Holding his guitar, he has a mission: save each world from its own crisis. Almost every time he succeeds, but always feels a little more gloomy. One day, a shooting star brings an illness to the city which turns people into zombies…  
  
(note: Chinese zombies and Western zombies are quite different).

description.en:
Chu Mu, a young man from the Chu family, encounters betrayal from his soul pet, leading to his family’s downfall. Pursued by enemies, he is captured and bound to Nightmare Island, forced to serve as a slave feeding the terrifying White Nightmare within him. Any misstep could result in his soul being devoured with no burial ground. To survive and seek revenge, Chu Mu must grow stronger.

Fortunately, Chu Mu forms a contract with a mutated Moonlight Fox soul pet, naming it Mo Ye. With Nightmare Island as his starting point, Chu Mu will script the tale of the strongest soul pet master.

In his final moments, he lamented that he was no better than a cockroach. Unexpectedly, the God of Cockroaches took his words seriously and reincarnated him as one! In a world filled with monsters and superpowers, Zhou Yi, now a tiny cockroach, must strive to survive against all odds.

Aqi (ah-chee), a boy with god-like strength, finally gets fed up with his fellow villagers are constantly relying on him to help them. So he leaves on an adventure to save the world! (but from what, we have yet to find out…)  
  
After quickly getting lost in the nearby forest, he finds a girl named Misu about to be eaten by the dangerous wildlife of the forest! Using his inhuman strength he saves her, and after finding out she can cook, he decides to bring her along on his adventures!

On the very first day he gets promoted, Gu Qingpei gets thrown the Chairman's son, who he was unable to raise well. Huh? He was supposed to 'babysit'? This irritable, overbearing army ruffian was always dramatically opposed to him. If he, Gu Qingpei, was unable to deal with this rough brat, how could he persuade the employees in his company? The days pass in anxiety with the open strife between the two. It's just that their relationship was developing in the opposite of what one would expect...

The Third Prince of the human race, determined to uncover the truth behind his eldest sister's disappearance, chooses to disguise himself as a woman and take his younger sister's place in a political marriage. The "husband" he must face is the bloodthirsty Beastman Crown Prince, Ming Sheng.
To buy time for his investigation, Lu Mi plays the role of a deeply infatuated princess, meticulously studying the Prince's preferences and professing his love in increasingly creative ways.
Meanwhile, Ming Sheng—discriminated against due to his "impure" bloodline—uses the mask of a tyrant for protection. Though he had intentionally terrified all previous suitors away, he unexpectedly encounters Lu Mi, who refuses to play by the rules. Having never been truly loved, Ming Sheng gradually loses his composure, revealing his weaknesses under Lu Mi's feigned yet burning "affection."

As time passed, people gradually forgot about their existence. The demons that were forgotten were all faced with the fate of disappearing…… there is a family that serves to guard and protect the only demon remaining in the world. Liu Yuru spent fifteen years as a model young lady in search of a good husband, but on the eve of her engagement, she was forced to marry the notorious playboy Gu Jiu Si from Yangzhou. Marrying such a man felt like ruining her life, especially when she discovered that he was also forced to marry her. Heartbroken, Liu Yuru locked herself in her room for three days before realizing something. If she had to marry such a playboy, why should she strive to be the perfect lady? So, on the third day of her marriage, this renowned gentlewoman, trembling and holding a knife, bravely entered a brothel, where a drunken Gu Jiu Si simply said to her, "Get up." Afterward, Gu Jiu Si experienced great ups and downs, rising from a fallen playboy to a high-ranking official, with this woman by his side, supporting him with her delicate frame, saying, "Get up." Even if he were to be crushed and torn apart, he would struggle to rise from the mud, gritting his teeth to carry her through this life. For Liu Yuru, in her first fifteen years, she thought living was about finding a good man. It was only when she met Gu Jiu Si that she understood a good man would make you realize you are alive for yourself. — May I use this flesh and blood to shield her from wind and rain, protecting her dress from dust and keeping her hair free of frost.
A wise and clear-headed young lady vs. a youthful and carefree playboy.

Qianyue, a downtrodden woman beaten down by life, was on the verge of leaping from her balcony when her coworker Lin Che—someone she barely knows—suddenly appeared. Massive, inhuman, black hands dragged her back to reality. 

"Let's make a deal about life and death," he said. And before she knew it, Qianyue had stepped into Lin Che's sweet trap, falling deeper and deeper with every step... until she finally uncovers his dark intentions.

The story follows a band of young men with extraordinary martial arts abilities, battling the evil crime lords that spread drugs, prostitution and misery on the streets of hong kong which ends up being a much bigger problem than they realise as their fight to defeat evil, is spread across most of Asia. Their main enemy has been the infamous Rakshasa sect run by a powerful kung fu master they call the Fiery God. At its heart, is a story of brotherhood, loyalty and family tragedy that shapes these men into who they are. A story that even tells the struggles of the enemies they fight , with their own backstories that show their often sad and horrifying upbringing that drives their ambitions.

As a behaviour manipulator, Cheng Ran was good at finding human’s weaknesses and manipulating their behaviour. He thought he knew the human heart like the back of his hand: “The reward I want is... to kill you.” 

Cheng Ran knelt on the ground, his hand and chin perched on Han Qi's knee, looking into Han Qi's eyes like a puppy with his head tilted. “Start a fire, I'll hold onto your corpse, and get burned into ashes along with this house. Our ashes, the ashes of this world, muddled together, never to be separated again.” Cheng Ran is confident that what he said in this moment are love words that Han Qi wanted to hear the most. Han Qi has indeed frozen. “It’s impossible to burn humans into ashes by burning the house.” 

Han Qi gently caressed Cheng Ran's head with his hand, like soothing a little puppy. He pondered for a while and slowly said: “The body has to be burned in an incinerator at a high temperature of 1,000° for an hour. Afterwards, use a hammer to break the calcified bones. Finally, you had to grind it finely, for it to become ashes.” Cheng Ran was surprised at Han Qi's knowledge of the cremation process, and he’s even more surprised that his thoughts seem to be deviated from expectations. “Okay.” Han Qi looked at Cheng Ran's eyes intently. 

Okay? Cheng Ran was shocked. What's okay about it? That was dirty talk! I’m not asking you to execute it! Cheng Ran thought using his body would get the other party to open up, but unexpectedly the other party used his heart and accompanied him in this forbidden game.

description.en:
On a quest to solve her mother's mysterious disappearance, half-human Xiao Wan steps onto a time-travelling train and takes up the arduous task of helping people out with problems regarding their fate. She weaves her way through cities rich with history, crossing paths with the likes of a quick-witted, courageous Roman general and a reckless, possessive Babylonian king. Yet dilemma after dilemma of romance seems to come her way... 

It is said that the fruits of labor from one's present life were yieded from seeds planted in one's past life. The train can only keep moving if the seeds of the past are sowed with purpose, and rid of tragedy. As the train approaches its final destination, will Xiao Wan be able to solve the final mystery?
description.pt-br: Em uma missão para resolver o misterioso desaparecimento de sua mãe, a meio-humana Xiao Wan entra em um trem que viaja no tempo e assume a árdua tarefa de ajudar as pessoas com problemas relacionados ao seu destino. Ela percorre cidades ricas em história, cruzando caminhos com gente como um general romano perspicaz e corajoso e um rei babilônico imprudente e possessivo. No entanto, dilema após dilema de romance parece surgir em seu caminho... Diz-se que os frutos do trabalho da vida presente de alguém foram colhidos de sementes plantadas na vida passada. O trem só pode continuar se movendo se as sementes do passado forem plantadas com propósito e se livrarem da tragédia.
